name: bandit.extortion_committed_contact_bootstrap_mcw
description: Bootstrap one ordinary production cadence from the current-executable R-009 pre-opportunity McWilliams save, then perform a normal full save and capture the resulting world for the next committed-contact setup stage. The dedicated profile deliberately sends no post-load Return key because this build binds Return to the Actions menu; this route never rewrites a save or authoritatively invents hostile state.

steps.label: post_load_preopportunity_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the current executable has loaded the copied production save to the live gameplay HUD
steps.abort_reason: the current-executable bootstrap save did not reach a real gameplay HUD

steps.label: wait_one_dispatch_cadence
steps.expected_visible_fact: one ordinary 30-minute gameplay wait gives the production scheduler its next dispatch cadence

steps.label: audit_player_save_before_full_save
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created save was absent before the native Save-and-Quit action

steps.label: open_full_save_after_cadence
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Save and quit confirmation prompt is visible before any save-exit confirmation
steps.abort_reason: the native Save and quit confirmation prompt was not visible after the Save command

steps.label: confirm_full_save_after_cadence
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Yes confirmation must produce a newer production save through the following named save-mtime transition

steps.label: audit_player_save_after_full_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit action did not update the production save

steps.label: audit_production_cadence_state
steps.abort_reason: the production-created bootstrap world no longer contained its named bandit site
steps.expected_immediate_state: read-only audit records the production owner's saved opportunity, decision, and reservation state without shaping it

evidence_contract.claim: one current-executable production cadence is run from a previous ordinary full-save artifact, then a new ordinary full save captures the resulting state for the next setup stage
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the harness copies a current-executable save with save_transforms=[]; after the HUD gate it only invokes the native wait menu and the Save-and-Quit prompt's visible Yes selection
evidence_contract.terminal: the run is only setup evidence and stops after a normal full save; it does not claim shakedown behavior
